findings.finding: summarize_fr_coverage` treats `rows == []` as proof that the Screens table could not be parsed. A manifest with a syntactically valid Screens header and separator but zero screen rows is parsed successfully; it simply has no mappings. With declared FRs, this produces the misleading “no Screens rows parsed (check manifest format)” message, contrary to the requirement to distinguish parse failure from orphaned/unmapped FRs.
findings.suggestion: Have `parse_screens_table` return parsing status in addition to rows (for example, `table_found_and_valid`), or introduce a parser result type. Use that status to emit the parse-failure diagnostic only when headers/required columns cannot be parsed; report a valid empty table as having no screen mappings.  Overall assessment: The requested B5 schema-field correction, column-tolerant parser, Non-UI exemption behavior, template guidance, and substantive regression tests are implemented. This small diagnostic edge case should be corrected before shipping if exact coverage-report semantics are required.  SHIPWRIGHT_VERDICT: revise
